classification.difficultyReason: Translate the doorstop diagram into triangular area times prism width, then scale the volume of one doorstop to 100 identical objects.

content.prompt:
Charya is going to make 100 doorstops for his school with recycled plastic.
The doorstops will be in the shape of a triangular prism with these dimensions.
What volume of plastic will he need to make all 100 door stops?

spec.description: Shallow wedge with triangular face, narrow sloping top and darker right rectangular face; depth runs up-right. No right-angle mark.
spec.mathematics: Triangular-prism model: A=(0,0,0), B=(6.8,0,0), C=(6.8,1.2,0), with D,E,F corresponding at depth 1.8. Projection uses a positive horizontal and vertical depth displacement. Visible faces ABC, ADFC and BEFC; obscured edges DE and EF-to-triangle interior connections are not introduced. The intended perpendicular cross-section dimensions require review.
